note: General encouragement, not scripture. Each quote lists where it was published; proverbs have no author.

quotes.text: Well done is better than well said.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: Lost time is never found again.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: Dost thou love life? Then do not squander time, for that's the stuff life is made of.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: The best way out is always through.
quotes.author: Robert Frost

quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quotes.author: Will Durant

quotes.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Laozi
quotes.source: Tao Te Ching, ch. 64 (common English rendering)

quotes.text: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.text: Little by little, one travels far.
Slow and steady wins the race.
quotes.source: Proverb, after Aesop's The Tortoise and the Hare
